normalization_consistency_check.scope: Exact model check, supplementary to the general proof.
normalization_consistency_check.model: For p=z^n+v with |v|=1, the normalized deformed polynomial is again a translated power with a unimodular critical value. Thus every normalized length is C_n.
normalization_consistency_check.coefficients: E_k=C_n T(x,k)-2 pi T(a,k)^2. The ratio T(a,k)^2/T(x,k) increases to C_n/(2 pi), since its consecutive ratio is (k+a)^2/((k+1)(k+x)) and a^2-x=b^2>0. Hence all E_k are nonnegative and their sum is U_n-C_n.
normalization_consistency_check.stationary_check: The direct model coefficients are h_n=bv, h_(2n)=s_b v^2, [beta]h_n(F_beta)=b v^2, and gamma_2=t_b v^2. The stationary orthogonality and the universal second-coefficient identity agree with these exact model formulas.
